description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationConfirmationAndRating" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialJobOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InterviewNegotiation" name="Interview negotiation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HiringIntention" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" name="Applicant rating and job status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JobApplication"
                      name="Job application"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendApplication"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicationConfirmationAndRating"
                      name="Application confirmation and rating"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendApplicationConfirmationAndRating"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicationConfirmationAndRating"
                      messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PotentialJobOffer"
                      name="Potential job offer"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPotentialJobOffer"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceivePotentialJobOffer"
                      messageRef="Message_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewNegotiation"
                      name="Interview negotiation"
                      sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"
                      targetRef="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation"
                      messageRef="Message_InterviewNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HiringIntention"
                      name="Hiring intention"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendHiringIntention"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveHiringIntention"
                      messageRef="Message_HiringIntention"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"
                      name="Company rating and job status"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"
                      messageRef="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Job applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_JobSearch" name="Begin job search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Write and send job application"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApplicationConfirmationAndRating"
                      name="Receive application confirmation and rating"
                      messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePotentialJobOffer"
                      name="Receive potential job offer"
                      messageRef="Message_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewChoice"
                           name="Negotiate an interview?"
                           default="Flow_ApplicantNoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview"
                   name="Negotiate interview"
                   messageRef="Message_InterviewNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveHiringIntention"
                      name="Receive company hiring intention"
                      messageRef="Message_HiringIntention"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReviewAndJobOutcomeSplit" name="Continue review and job outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"
                      name="Receive company rating and job status"
                      messageRef="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent"
                           name="Did the job become permanent?"
                           default="Flow_JobNotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold"
                           name="Did you rate the company C or less?"
                           default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Permanent" name="Job is permanent; process ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantStartToApplication" sourceRef="StartEvent_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicationToConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicationConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToReport" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplicationConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportToOffer" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceivePotentialJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToInterviewChoice" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePotentialJobOffer" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantYesInterview" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewChoice" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantNoInterview" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantInterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApplicantInterviewToHiringIntention" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantInterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHiringIntention"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HiringIntentionToProbation" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveHiringIntention" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationToCompanyRating" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatingToSplit" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewAndJobOutcomeSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToOneYearWait" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewAndJobOutcomeSplit" targetRef="Event_WaitOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneYearToReviewVisible" sourceRef="Event_WaitOneYear" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToJobOutcome" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewAndJobOutcomeSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobOutcomeToPermanentDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobIsPermanent" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCOrLess" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold" targetRef="Task_ReceivePotentialJobOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_Permanent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmApplication" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicationConfirmationAndRating"
                   name="Send application confirmation and rating"
                   messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPotentialJobOffer"
                   name="Send potential job offer"
                   messageRef="Message_PotentialJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyInterviewChoice"
                           name="Is an interview negotiated?"
                           default="Flow_CompanyNoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation"
                      name="Handle interview negotiation"
                      messageRef="Message_InterviewNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyInterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview choice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant"
                           name="Does the company want the applicant to work there?"
                           default="Flow_CompanyDoesNotWantApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendHiringIntention"
                   name="Tell applicant the company wants them to work there"
                   messageRef="Message_HiringIntention"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyProbation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineJobStatus" name="Determine whether the job becomes permanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"
                   name="Send applicant rating and job status"
                   messageRef="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyWorkComplete" name="Company actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoHiringIntention" name="Company does not want applicant to work there"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyStartToConfirm" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmToRateApplication" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmApplication" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateApplicationToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Task_SendApplicationConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicationConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_SendPotentialJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToCompanyInterviewChoice" sourceRef="Task_SendPotentialJobOffer" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyInterviewChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyYesInterview" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyInterviewChoice" targetRef="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyNoInterview" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyInterviewChoice" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyInterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyInterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyInterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyInterviewToHiringDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyInterviewMerge" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyWantsApplicant" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendHiringIntention">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyDoesNotWantApplicant" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="EndEvent_NoHiringIntention"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HiringIntentionToProbation" sourceRef="Task_SendHiringIntention" targetRef="Task_CompanyProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyProbationToRateApplicant" sourceRef="Task_CompanyProbation" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateApplicantToDetermineStatus" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Task_DetermineJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineStatusToSendOutcome" sourceRef="Task_DetermineJobStatus" targetRef="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendOutcomeToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyWorkComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
